app_store.scope: Apple's public listing reports version 5.1.0. It does not disclose the approved build number or prove correspondence to a source commit. Availability can vary by storefront and device.

published_source.scope: Oath Wallet 5.1.1, build 111 source release. App Store availability is recorded separately. Dated guides and reviews retain their original evidence scope.

guide_source.scope: Pinned source used by the existing product guides; not a verified match to the current App Store binary.

security_review.limitations: The whole-wallet review remains incomplete. Findings, fixes and tests apply to their recorded source commits; later releases do not automatically inherit coverage. No independent security-company certification or independently reproduced App Store binary match is established.

review.limitations: The whole-wallet review remains incomplete. Findings, fixes and tests apply to their recorded source commits; later releases do not automatically inherit coverage. No independent security-company certification or independently reproduced App Store binary match is established.

source_evidence.scope: Pinned source excerpts, not an independent audit or confirmation of the current App Store version.

compatibility.note: Use app_store, published_source and security_review. An unknown App Store build or binary-to-source correspondence is null.
